_comment: temper-rust-router's expected-failure manifest, the sibling of
wasm_expected_failures.json (temper-drc-rs), wasm_expected_failures_geometry.json,
wasm_expected_failures_thermal.json, wasm_expected_failures_router_core.json,
wasm_expected_failures_design_bundle.json, wasm_expected_failures_constraint_compiler.json,
wasm_expected_failures_quality_oracle.json, wasm_expected_failures_io_types.json and
wasm_expected_failures_pcl_ir.json. Same contract -- see wasm_expected_failures.json's
_comment for why divergences are LISTED and executed rather than deleted or cfg'd out.
It is a separate file rather than more entries in a shared one because run_wasm_tests.mjs
exits non-zero on an ORPHAN EXCLUSION: a manifest entry naming no registered test. Point
the runner at this one with `--expected-failures
tools/wasm/wasm_expected_failures_rust_router.json` when the module carries
temper-rust-router alone.
THIS FILE IS EMPTY, AND THAT IS A RESULT RATHER THAN AN OMISSION.
Measured 2026-08-11 with `node tools/wasm/run_wasm_tests.mjs` against the actual
`--no-default-features --features rust-router-wasm-test-registry` build: 20 registered,
20 executed, 20 passed, 0 failed, 0 expected-fail, 0 other. Registered and executable
COINCIDE for this crate, the same shape as temper-design-bundle's 24/24 and
temper-io-types's 144/144: no entry in packages/temper-rust-router/src/
wasm_test_registry.rs carries its own cfg. An empty manifest is NOT a weaker gate: with
nothing excluded, every one of the 20 executable tests is load-bearing and any regression
on wasm32 turns the step red immediately.
--- Native comparison (R19), diffed by name not just counted --------------------
`cargo test --no-default-features --manifest-path
packages/temper-rust-router/Cargo.toml` runs 23 lib tests, all passing: the 20 wasm32
names above, PLUS 3 `proptests::*` tests (`f32s_from_le_bytes`'s round-trip properties:
p1_f32s_round_trip, p2_output_length_input_div_4, p3_zero_bytes_decode_to_zero`) that use
the `proptest` dev-dependency, which is not linked into the ordinary (non-test) build this
registry compiles into -- the same `proptest-dev-dependency` class every other crate on
the tier already excludes on the same grounds (this crate's own wasm_test_registry.rs
header names it explicitly). No `--lib` flag is needed on native_test_args: this crate's
`tests/*.rs` integration files do not reference pyo3 (unlike temper-orchestration's), so a
plain `cargo test --no-default-features` already runs cleanly. Diffed name-for-name: the
20 wasm32 names are an EXACT SUBSET of the 23 native lib names, all 20 pass on both sides,
0 wasm32_only, 0 disagreement.
